source.name: Cloudflare Radar
source.note: Crawler selection and purpose classification follow Cloudflare Radar, which measures observed crawler traffic rather than estimating importance. Traffic share moves month to month, so no ranking is stored here — only membership and purpose, which are stable.

search.label: Search engines
search.intent: keep the site out of the major search indexes
search.consequence: These search engines cannot crawl the site, so its pages will not appear in their results. Note that robots.txt does not remove URLs that are already indexed — it stops them being re-crawled.
search.remedy: Remove the matching Disallow rule, or give these crawlers their own group with an Allow rule. Path matching is longest-wins, so a specific Allow overrides a broader Disallow.
search.upside: Pages can be discovered and ranked in the major search indexes.

ai_search.label: AI answer engines
ai_search.intent: keep the site out of AI-generated answers
ai_search.consequence: The site cannot be cited as a source in AI-generated answers. Unlike training crawlers these send referral traffic, so blocking them forfeits those visits.
ai_search.remedy: Remove the matching Disallow rule, or allow these agents on the sections you want cited.
ai_search.upside: The site can be cited as a source in AI-generated answers, which is an increasingly common way people arrive at a page.

ai_user.label: User-triggered AI fetches
ai_user.intent: prevent assistants from fetching pages when a person asks for them
ai_user.consequence: When someone asks an assistant to open a page on this site, it cannot be retrieved. These requests are made because a person asked for that specific page, not to collect content in bulk.
ai_user.remedy: Allow these agents globally, or only on the sections you want retrievable.
ai_user.upside: When someone asks an assistant to open a page on this site, it loads.

social.label: Social link previews
social.intent: prevent link previews on social platforms
social.consequence: Links to this site shared on these platforms render as a bare URL, with no title, description or image.
social.remedy: Allow these agents, or at least the pages that get shared, along with the images they reference.
social.upside: Links shared on social platforms and in chat render with a title, description and image.

ai_training.label: AI training crawlers
ai_training.intent: prevent this content being used as model training data
ai_training.consequence: These crawlers cannot retrieve content from the site, so it will not be collected as training data. They send no traffic back, and blocking them does not affect search rankings.
ai_training.remedy: Remove the site-wide block, or replace it with narrower path restrictions.
ai_training.upside: These crawlers may use the site's content as model training data.
